subject: NovaMed QBR: slot ownership and compact run-of-show
messages:
From: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Huang <sam.huang@novamedtech.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — Week of Dec 4 windows

Hi Priya,

Quick ask — our exec team has a travel overlap the week we originally set for the QBR (Dec 4–6). Can we compress the QBR into a compact run (exec briefing + technical breakouts) and shift to the week of Dec 11, or alternatively, run a split day: morning (exec) + afternoon (tech) on Dec 4?

What we need from you:
- A few firm slot options (US-west friendly) for both the exec and tech segments.
- Who would own the exec run-of-show vs the technical deep-dive.
- Any constraints on recordings or materials sharing (we have internal compliance to note).

I've attached the current agenda and our attendee list so you can see decision-makers and technical owners. Also cc'ing Sam from Ops to loop procurement if we need to adjust the timeline on their side.

Attachments: current-agenda.pdf, attendee-list.csv

Thanks — apologize for the short notice.

Best,
Aliya
Director, Customer Success
NovaMed Tech

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — Week of Dec 4 windows

Aliya — thanks for the heads up. Understandable. We can do either: (A) a compact, single-day run with two timeboxes (exec + tech) on Dec 4, or (B) move to the week of Dec 11 if you prefer split days.

Immediate suggestions (US‑PST windows):
- Dec 4 (compact): 09:00–10:00 PT (exec), 13:00–15:00 PT (technical deep-dive + Q&A)
- Dec 11 (split): Dec 11 AM for exec (09:00–10:00 PT), Dec 12 PM for tech (13:00–15:00 PT)

Ownership proposal:
- Exec run-of-show owner: Priya N. (I will handle slides, exec pre-brief, and recording permissions).
- Tech deep-dive owner: Karthik I. (will be lead presenter and manage breakout rooms).
- Recording/logistics: Stephanie N. (record, publish materials to Drive, capture action items).

If those owners look good, Karthik can send a narrow slots ICS for the tech segment and Stephanie will confirm recording policy (HIPAA-adjacent note from your compliance mention).

Cc'ing Sam in case procurement wants to lock dates. We'll keep this tight — short run-of-show and an explicit fallback if execs need a hard shift.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — Week of Dec 4 windows

Thanks — quick technical note from my side. If we do the compact day on Dec 4, the technical segment will be most valuable if we structure it as: 60m architecture walk + 30m integration Q&A + 30m hands-on with sample dataset. That means we should reserve a continuous 2-hour block (13:00–15:00 PT) so we don't fragment the flow.

Please confirm who from your engineering team will attend (names and titles) so we can tune demos and pre-load a small sample dataset (we'll need a data share link or ephemeral S3 access).

Proposed attendee asks (tech):
- Lead architect or engineering manager (for design questions)
- Data owner (for access checks)
- DevOps/cloud lead (for deployment constraints)

I attached a quick ICS with candidate slots and a short tech outline.

Attachments: tech-deep-dive-slots.ics

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Huang <sam.huang@novamedtech.com>, procurement@novamedtech.com
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 13:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — Week of Dec 4 windows

This is helpful — thanks, team. We prefer the compact Dec 4 option if we can make the exec portion tight (no more than 45m) — execs want a strategic roadmap and key decision points only. The 13:00–15:00 PT tech window works for our engineers.

Attendees (prelim):
- CEO: Rebecca Lin (exec) — will join the 09:00–09:45 PT block
- VP Engineering: Sam Huang — will join both blocks
- Platform Lead: Mateo Alvarez — technical lead for the sample dataset
- Procurement: procurement@novamedtech.com — cc'd for timeline

We are also reviewing an internal PO draft that may affect procurement timing; attaching the draft (nova_po_draft.pdf).

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can Redwood confirm the recording retention policy and whether we can restrict access to exec recording to named attendees only?
2) Can you share a brief run-of-show (10–12 bullets) so I can re-share with Rebecca?

Attachments: nova_po_draft.pdf

Best,
Aliya

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Sam Huang <sam.huang@novamedtech.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — Week of Dec 4 windows

Aliya — all good. Confirming: compact day on Dec 4 with the following concrete plan and ownership.

Run-of-show (compact):
1) 09:00–09:45 PT — Exec briefing (Priya) — strategic roadmap, success metrics, decision asks
2) 09:45–10:00 PT — Action items and immediate next steps
3) 11:30–12:00 PT — Break / internal prep (optional)
4) 13:00–14:00 PT — Tech architecture walk (Karthik)
5) 14:00–14:30 PT — Integration Q&A (Karthik + Platform Lead)
6) 14:30–15:00 PT — Hands-on demo with sample dataset (Karthik + Mateo)
7) 15:00–15:15 PT — Wrap and capture action items (Stephanie)

Recording policy: we will record both sessions by default. Exec recording will be uploaded to a restricted Drive folder and shared only with named attendees (we'll enforce via Drive ACLs). Stephanie will own publishing and access control. If you need an additional NDA-level control, we can coordinate with our legal team but that will add 24–48 hours to delivery.

Next steps:
- Aliya: confirm attendee list (names/titles) for the tech block and whether we can get a sample dataset link by Nov 27.
- Sam / procurement: flag if PO timing affects go/no-go for early December.
- Karthik: will finalize the tech slide deck and pre-load a demo dataset (requires ephemeral S3 credentials).
- Stephanie: will prepare run_of_show_v2.docx and set up the restricted Drive folder.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567) — I'll update the milestone to "QBR scheduled (Dec 4)" once we have final attendee confirmation.

I've attached a first draft run-of-show to circulate.

Attachments: run_of_show_v2.docx

Thanks — Priya

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Aliya Thompson <aliya@novamedtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaMed QBR — slot ownership and compact run-of-show

Quick follow-up: Stephanie has set the Drive folder and locked ACLs; exec recording access will be restricted to the attendee emails you confirm. Stephanie — can you confirm you have publishing rights and will send the restricted link after the meeting?

Also adding a brief contingency: if Rebecca must cancel at the last minute, we'll run the exec segment with the VP (Sam) in attendance and record a 10‑minute exec summary for Rebecca to watch asynchronously.

Final asks: please reply-all with the final attendee emails by end of day Nov 27 and confirm whether we should request ephemeral S3 access (yes/no) for the hands-on demo.

Thanks — Priya
